key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to cut expensive simulator calls in high-dimensional process design.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical way to optimize industrial flowsheets and other costly engineering simulators under tight computational budgets.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to identify and optimize in a reduced set of influential variables.
Model low- and high-fidelity simulators jointly with a fidelity-aware Gaussian process.
Allocate evaluations with a cost-aware acquisition rule plus cooldown and promotion mechanisms.
evidence_signal: The method was tested on two industrial simulators—plasmid DNA bioprocessing in SuperPro Designer and green fuel synthesis in Aspen HYSYS—showing fewer high-fidelity evaluations while remaining competitive with single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the sensitivity analysis and fidelity correlation, so weak low-fidelity models or poor variable screening could reduce gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
